name: Bearing Children
overview: Scripture reveals that bearing children is a divine blessing and responsibility, as God commands humanity to be fruitful and multiply, filling the earth and exercising stewardship over creation (Genesis 1:28). Although the fall introduced sorrow and pain in childbirth (Genesis 3:16), God’s grace enables joy and purpose in motherhood, turning barrenness into fruitful joy (Psalms 113:9). Children are portrayed as a precious heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), and parents are instructed to diligently train and correct their children in the ways of the Lord, ensuring they grow in wisdom and righteousness (Proverbs 22:6, 15).
